book.name: HIMU NATONIQA MATAQTIWHQA
book.title: Jesus Christ HIHTA NATONIQAT MAHTAKNA Ayay John aw’i

content: The Angel and the Little Scroll

Pu nu piw sukw hoṅviayat a’nö öqalay’taqat aw yori. Pam ōmawuy yuwsi’k̇aṅw taṅaqwunut akw qötösomiwk̇aṅw ōṅaqw hāwi, tutuvenit púrukiwtaqat yawk̇aṅwo. Put taywaat pas tāwat an tāla; noqw hok̇aat ūwiṅwuy wupa’leletaqat panta.
Noqw pam putvaqw kuhkuy akw pātuwaqatsit aqw wuhku, pu suyvaqw tutskwat aw’i.
Pu wukotohowuy höykuqat an a’nö hiṅqawu. Noqw put hiṅqawhq, pahsat pu tsaṅe’sikip yoy’umuki hihta lavayhtoti.
Noqw tsaṅe’sikip yoy’umuki lavayhtotiqw, nu as pēnaniqey anhti. Noqw pay hakiy tönaat ōṅaqw inumi paṅqawu: Pay um tsaṅe’sikip yoy’umuki hin lavayhtotiqw put tupk̇e’, qa pēnani.
Pahsat pu i’ hoṅviaya ura nu tuwaqw, pātuwaqatsit aqwnik̇aṅw pu tūwaqatsit aqw wuhkukiwtaqa ōmiq may ītat,

Pas qaöwílvayhtiqe, pas soon pāpu sȫwuniqat paṅqawu, God aw yank̇aṅwo, God pas sutsep qátuhqat sohsok hihta yúkuhqat aw’i, ōveqatsit‐nik̇aṅw pu aṅ himu hinyuṅqata, pu pātuwaqatsit‐nik̇aṅw aṅqe’ himu hinyuṅqat yúkuhqata.
Noqw tsáṅe’nihqat hoṅviayat töqtiqat aw pitu. Noqw pep pu’ God tunatyaat as tupkiwtaqa aw antsaniwni, pam lavay’aymuy amumi hin lavayhtiqat pan’i.
Noqw nu hakiy ōṅaqw tönayat navotq, pam inumi paṅqawu: Um hoṅviayat pātuwaqatsit aqwnik̇aṅw pu tūwaqatsit aqw wuhkukqat awnen, tutuvenhoyat púruk’iwtaqat yawtaqat put aṅqw kwúsuni.
Noqw ōviy nu put awnihqe aw paṅqawu: Um as nuy tutuvenhoyat máqani. Noqw pam inumi paṅqawu: Kwúsuu, nen um sówani. Pam soon uhponoy qa a’nö tsiptani; nīk̇aṅw uhmoaṅaqw momospalat an kwáṅwni.
Noqw ōviy nu put māyat aṅqw tutuvenhoyat kwúsuhqe put sowa. Noqw antsa imoaṅaqw momospalat an kwaṅwti. Nīk̇aṅw panis nuy put sowaqw, pahsat pay ivonoveq tsipti.
Noqw pam inumi paṅqawu: Pay um nāt piw pas hīhihtuy sinmuy amumi yuaatani, pu aṅqe’ nanāpwatuy sinoiwyuṅqamuyu amumii, pu lavaymakiway’yuṅqamuyu, pu pas momṅwituyu.
